payload.body: GO 143 (light), utilz-ic: run-0083m.sh again with security faked, red then green, on both bashes, beside cc's 142. The keychain read is the class 0082 fixed, a test reaching the user's own state, so prove it closed this time. For both the red and the green, list every command the new tests and the doctor and status tests resolve outside the fakes directory. The suite's PATH, or a trace of command -v for open, xcodebuild, pgrep, security, launchctl, lsregister, codesign, osascript and defaults, will do. The answer should be none, or name each one with why it is safe. Then the END with counts as before.
